reference_solution: Use the query in reference.sql: SELECT a.variant, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS exposed_users, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS converted_users FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN conversions c ON c.user_id=a.user_id GROUP BY a.variant ORDER BY a.variant;
explanation: The reference separates validation from the core SQL behavior, makes tie-breaking explicit, and verifies the result against the stated invariants.

trade_off_analysis: Correctness and explainability are preferred over premature optimization.
The production extension adds observability and recovery before higher throughput.
